title: Carbon Policy and the Emissions Implications of Electric Vehicles
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Will a carbon tax improve the welfare consequences of policies to promote electric vehicles? This paper examines when a complementarity could exist between carbon pricing and high electric vehicle adoption. We analyze electricity generation in recent years to show that in several regions, carbon pricing interacts with electric vehicle adoption. Under moderate carbon prices like those in effect today, additional electric vehicles will be more likely to be charged with coalfired generation than without carbon pricing. We confirm this finding using a detailed dynamic model that includes the transportation and power sectors. At much higher carbon prices, the effect reverses.
abstract_zh: 碳税能否改善促进电动汽车政策的福利后果？本文考察了碳定价与电动汽车的高普及率之间何时可能存在互补关系。我们分析了近年来的电力生产情况，表明在若干地区，碳定价与电动汽车的普及存在相互作用。在当前实行的适度碳价水平下，与没有碳定价的情形相比，新增的电动汽车更有可能以燃煤发电进行充电。我们利用一个包含交通与电力部门的详细动态模型证实了这一发现。而当碳价高得多时，该效应则会逆转。

Has Consumer Acceptance of Electric Vehicles Been Increasing? Evidence from Microdata on Every New Vehicle Sale in the United States
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) sales have been rapidly growing around the world, spurred by technology advances and policy actions. This study leverages rich data on all individual new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States from 2014 to 2020. We examine how EV attributes, prices, and sales have evolved, exploring substantial heterogeneity across geography, vehicle class, price range, and demographics. We use a matching analysis to compare EVs to similar conventional vehicles to find that EVs have been surprisingly competitive in very recent years. This suggests that constrained supply is an important determinant of the low overall EV market share.
abstract_zh: 在技术进步和政策行动的推动下，全球电动汽车（EV）销量迅速增长。本研究利用了2014年至2020年间在美国售出的所有个体新型轻型车辆的丰富数据。我们考察了电动汽车的属性、价格和销量是如何演变的，并探讨了其在地理、车辆类别、价格区间和人口特征方面存在的显著异质性。我们采用匹配分析，将电动汽车与相似的传统燃油车进行比较，发现电动汽车在最近几年竞争力出人意料地强。这表明，供给受限是电动汽车整体市场份额较低的一个重要决定因素。

title: Pricing Indirect Emissions Accelerates Low-Carbon Transition of US Light Vehicle Sector
abstract: Large-scale electric vehicle adoption can greatly reduce emissions from vehicle tailpipes. However, analysts have cautioned that it can come with increased indirect emissions from electricity and battery production that are not commonly regulated by transport policies. We combine integrated energy modeling and life cycle assessment to compare optimal policy scenarios that price emissions at the tailpipe only, versus both tailpipe and indirect emissions. Surprisingly, scenarios that also price indirect emissions exhibit higher, rather than reduced, sales of electric vehicles, while yielding lower cumulative tailpipe and indirect emissions. Expected technological change ensures that emissions from electricity and battery production are more than offset by reduced emissions of gasoline production. Given continued decarbonization of electricity supply, results show that a large-scale adoption of electric vehicles is able to reduce CO2 emissions through more channels than previously expected. Further, carbon pricing of stationary sources will also favor electric vehicles.
abstract_zh: 大规模采用电动汽车可以显著减少车辆尾气排放。然而，分析人士警告称，电动汽车可能伴随电力和电池生产带来的间接排放增加，而这些排放通常不受交通政策的监管。我们将综合能源模型与生命周期评价相结合，比较两种最优政策情景：一种仅对尾气排放定价，另一种则同时对尾气排放和间接排放定价。令人意外的是，同时对间接排放定价的情景中，电动汽车的销量反而更高，同时累计的尾气排放和间接排放却更低。随着技术变革的预期发生，电力和电池生产的排放将被汽油生产排放的减少所更多地抵消。在电力供应持续脱碳的前提下，结果表明，大规模采用电动汽车能够通过比此前预期更多的渠道减少二氧化碳排放。此外，对固定排放源征收碳价也将有利于电动汽车。
